tool.name: OGS: AddLayer
tool.description: Adds a layer to an existing mesh.
tool.command: ln -sf '$input_mesh_file' 'input_mesh_file.vtu'; AddLayer --input-mesh-file 'input_mesh_file.vtu' #if str($layer_tickness) --layer-tickness '$layer_tickness' #end if $add_layer_on_bottom $copy_material_ids #if str($set_material_id) --set-material-id '$set_material_id' #end if --output-mesh-file output_1.vtu

param.label: input mesh file
param.help: Input (.vtu). The name of the file containing the mesh

param.label: layer tickness
param.help: the thickness of the new layer

param.label: add layer on bottom
param.help: Per default the layer is add on the top, if this argument is set the layer is add on the bottom.

param.label: copy material ids
param.help: Copy the existing material distribution of the layer which is to be extended. If the switch isn't given a new material id will be created.

param.label: set material id
param.help: the material id of the new layer

tool.help: Adds a layer to an existing mesh. The documentation is available at https://www.opengeosys.org/docs/tools/meshing/addlayer.
